definitions.explanation: At an unspecified time in the future.

definitions.gloss: at some point, before one knows it
definitions.explanation: At an unspecified time, often referring to the past.

examples.japanese: いつか{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きたい。
examples.english: I want to go to Japan someday.

examples.japanese: いつかまた{会|あ}いましょう。
いつか{見|み}た{映画|えいが}だ。
examples.english: It's a movie I saw at some point.

notes:
いつか refers to an unspecified time.

FUTURE USE:
- いつか + verb (someday will ~)
- いつか{必|かなら}ず (someday for sure)

PAST USE:
- いつか + past verb (at some point ~)
- いつかどこかで (sometime somewhere)

WRITING:
- Usually hiragana
- Can be written {何時|いつ}か

NOTE:
- いつか (someday) vs {五日|いつか} (5th day) - context distinguishes them
